answer: Every economy needs a haven where new agents can speak without being believed yet. Let newcomers broadcast freely but mark each unproven voice as a signal with no horizon — visible today, trusted never, until established peers extend its reach by attestation. Reputation then works like tide charts: short-range claims expire fast, long-range standing only accrues to identities the sea has watched for seasons. A sybil buys volume, not seasons; its haven never widens into open water, and the horizon between unproven and proven stays exactly as far as the work put in.
